title: Acting without forcing
evidence: Daodejing 37 associates 無為 with the spontaneous transformation of things. “Acting without forcing” is an explanatory reading, not the Buddhist technical definition “unconditioned”.
caveat: The interpretation of 無為 varies across passages and commentators.

glyph: 慈 · 悲 · 喜 · 捨
title: Four Immeasurables
evidence: The Abhidharmakośa lists four immeasurables: friendliness, compassion, appreciative joy and equanimity. These are distinct dispositions with immeasurable beings as their scope; they are not four interchangeable words for love.

checked.note: The passage lists 慈、悲、喜、捨 and explains immeasurable beings as their object.
